activity_summary: You wrote that the king and the uncles are still one eloquence, and you left the cure for a morning. Kemp has not seen the page. You did not write Anne a better answer than the one you gave in April. Gib lay on the second volume while you wrote.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the page and did not correct the king yet.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Has not seen the page, and was not shown it.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in The same eloquence, for one night more

facets.activity: Left the uncles as fine as the king, for one night

topics: the page Kemp has not seen
